name: Python Asyncio & Concurrency
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Prefer structured concurrency (`asyncio.TaskGroup` or bounded `ThreadPoolExecutor`), explicit cancellation propagation, and lock-free message queues (`queue.Queue`/`asyncio.Queue`). Never block an event loop or GTK main loop with synchronous I/O or `time.sleep`; marshal UI mutations cleanly onto the main thread (`GLib.idle_add`).

name: Python 3.11+ Type Discipline
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Use `from __future__ import annotations`, modern union syntax (`X | None`), `@dataclass(slots=True)` for hot value objects, `Protocol` for structural interfaces, and narrow `try/except` around boundary conversions. Avoid `Any` except at untyped FFI boundaries.

name: GTK4 & Libadwaita Native UI
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Target GTK4 idioms: `set_child`/`append`/`remove` instead of deprecated GTK3 `add`/`show_all`; bind CSS via `Gtk.CssProvider` at `STYLE_PROVIDER_PRIORITY_APPLICATION`; run slow work off the main thread and update UI via `GLib.idle_add` returning `GLib.SOURCE_REMOVE`.

name: SQL Indexing & Query Plans
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Design composite indexes matching equality columns before range/sort columns; eliminate N+1 loops using set-based `JOIN` or `WHERE id IN (...)` batching; inspect `EXPLAIN ANALYZE` for sequential scans on large tables; wrap schema mutations in explicit transactions with parameterized queries only.

name: Root-Cause Debugging Protocol
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Reproduce before patching: pinpoint the exact state transition or invariant violation causing the symptom rather than masking exceptions. Check lifecycle order, stale caches, race conditions, and boundary inputs (`None`, empty, Unicode, max size), and confirm the fix with a regression check.

name: REST & RPC Contract Craft
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Enforce strict request/response schemas, cursor-based pagination for growing datasets, `Idempotency-Key` support on mutating retries, consistent structured error envelopes with machine-readable codes, and explicit timeouts on every upstream call.

name: Linux Namespaces, /proc & IPC
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Use `/proc/<pid>/status` and `cgroup` inspection safely with `FileNotFoundError`/`ProcessLookupError` tolerance for exiting PIDs. For local air-gapping, prefer `unshare -r -n` + loopback `AF_UNIX` bridges and always clean up process groups cleanly (`SIGTERM` -> grace window -> `SIGKILL`).

name: systemd Services & Journald
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Write minimal hardened `.service` units (`Restart=on-failure`, `ProtectSystem=strict`, `NoNewPrivileges=yes`), inspect failures via `journalctl -u <unit> -n 80 --no-pager`, and prefer user-scoped `--user` units over root services whenever possible.

name: Git Bisect, Rebase & Recovery
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Keep commits atomic and buildable; use `git bisect run` to isolate regressions fast; recover lost commits cleanly with `git reflog`; never force-push shared history or rewrite commits someone else depends on without explicit confirmation.

name: Application Security & Threat Model
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Audit trust boundaries ruthlessly: parameterize SQL, pass `subprocess` arg lists (`shell=False`), validate path traversal (`resolve().is_relative_to()`), reject private/link-local targets on SSRF surfaces, store secrets outside git/logs, and verify server-side authorization on every action.

name: Applied Cryptography Standards
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Never roll custom primitives: use AEAD (`AES-256-GCM` or `ChaCha20-Poly1305`) with unique nonces, `Argon2id` for passwords, `HKDF` for key expansion, `hmac.compare_digest` for constant-time token verification, and `secrets` instead of `random`.

name: Idiomatic Rust & Borrow Checker
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Model invariants in the type system, propagate errors cleanly with `Result<T, E>` and `?` (avoid `.unwrap()` outside tests), prefer borrowing (`&str`, `&[T]`) over unnecessary `.clone()`, and eliminate lock contention by shrinking critical sections.

name: Defensive C POSIX Engineering
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Always check return values of `malloc`/`snprintf`/`readlink`, size buffers for null terminators and `PATH_MAX` margins cleanly, avoid `strcpy`/`sprintf`, compile with `-Wall -Wextra -Werror=format-security`, and verify memory safety under AddressSanitizer (`-fsanitize=address,undefined`).

name: Hardened Bash & POSIX Scripting
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Start bash scripts with `set -euo pipefail`, double-quote every variable expansion (`"$var"`), avoid parsing `ls`, use `mktemp` + `trap` cleanup for temporary directories, and syntax-verify with `bash -n` (and `shellcheck` principles).

name: Performance Optimization & Hot Paths
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Measure before optimizing: identify the dominant term (I/O, allocations, $O(N^2)$ scans, lock waits, or repeated disk reads). Replace quadratic lookups with hash/set indexing, hoist invariants out of loops, and memoize read-heavy state via mtime checks.

name: Memory Leaks & Resource Lifecycles
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Pair every allocation, file descriptor, mmap, or subprocess with a `with`/context manager or `try/finally` teardown. Clear weak/strong callback references (especially GObject signal handlers and timer IDs) when closing views or windows.

name: Deterministic Verification & Tests
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Test real behavior across realistic boundary cases using temp directories (`tmp_dir`) and isolated state overrides instead of over-mocking internals. Every test must pass reliably offline without timing-dependent flakiness.

name: Containers, Dockerfiles & OCI
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Use pinned base digests, multi-stage builds to exclude compilers from runtime layers, `.dockerignore` to keep context tiny, ordered layers (deps before app code), and run as a non-root UID with explicit healthchecks.

name: GitHub Actions & Release CI
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Pin action major versions (`actions/checkout@v4`), fail fast on lint/compile before heavy packaging steps, matrix cross-platform builds cleanly (`ubuntu-latest` / `windows-latest`), and avoid echoing secrets or interpolating untrusted PR text into shell commands.

name: Linear-Time Parsing & Safe Regex
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Never parse nested/recursive grammars with backtracking regex alone; guard against catastrophic ReDoS `(a+)+` patterns, pre-compile hot patterns with `re.compile`, and prefer explicit state-machine/recursive-descent parsers or stdlib JSON/AST modules.

name: Vulkan Unified Memory & iGPU Tuning
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: On 16 GB unified-memory laptops (e.g. Radeon 780M), enforce strict single-engine ownership (0.0 GB idle before swapping models), offload giant text encoders (`umt5_xxl`) to CPU RAM while pinning UNet/VAE carefully, and avoid memory fragmentation across rapid jobs.

name: FFmpeg Filtergraphs & Mastering
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Keep intermediate passes lossless (`libx264 -crf 0` or PNG frames), apply `scale=W:H:flags=lanczos` + mild `unsharp=5:5:0.75:3:3:0.0` before final `-pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart` mastering, and match target GOP/bitrate cleanly.

name: NumPy Vectorization & Lightweight ML
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Replace Python pixel/token loops with vectorized NumPy broadcasting (`float32`/`float64`), store compact model checkpoints cleanly in `.npz`, avoid unnecessary full-framework runtime overhead (`torch`) inside UI inference gates, and stabilize logs/exps cleanly.

name: Clean Architecture & Zero Duplication
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Keep functions single-purpose with shallow nesting and early returns; extract shared helpers instead of duplicating near-identical blocks; parameterize variants via tables/mappings; keep refactors tightly scoped to the requested change.
